method: Repository-authored data conversion. All source PNG RGB pixels compared before palette/mask adaptation. No archive code executed.
paletteLimit: Character GPO bindings and index-zero transparency are inferred. FONT7H index 1 white and index 2 black are screenshot-informed browser colors, not a proved DOS runtime palette.
review: 20 source backgrounds and selected sprite contact sheets inspected. All 20 browser background canvases matched decoded PNG RGBA pixels in Chrome 157.0.8103.50. Welcome and all four activities/three characters visually inspected in a browser contact sheet. Full integrated screen/DOM, narrow-layout, motion and production comparison remain Phase 6.
adaptations: 640x400 activity canvas uses integer 2x native backgrounds; scene placement and cadence are browser choices.
Luigi/Princess action sprites recovered; no separate practice-face sets found, so existing browser portrait adaptations remain.
Mario practice expression inset at native (142,21) matches the happy background RGB pixels exactly.
FONT7H index 1 is white for the glyph core and index 2 black for its outline, matching screenshot appearance; the DOS runtime palette remains unverified.
Index-zero sprite transparency and named GPO bindings are inferred, not proved runtime bindings.
Castle masonry tiles use a recovered block; sand masking and stationary pipe remain minimal browser adaptations.
OCASTLE/ENDF availability does not establish original invocation or graduation triggers.
